about_the_game:
Welcome to Cell Knights: TD, where a mazing tower defense game themed in a Cells

The game is still in progress but here's some of the content of this game:

Features:

  • Single-player campaign – Defend fountains and uncover the truth behind the outbreak.

  • Path-mazing tower defense – Build your own maze with 2x2 tower grid defenses that shape enemy movement to your advantage.

  • Unique Towers – A 2x2 Cell Knight that pop, freeze, spin, smash, clean, reveal, and accidentally speed up enemies!

  • Merge Towers - Merge towers and choose random book of stats to upgrade.

  • Unique Items – Carefully choose and place your loot items to cell knights to outsmart the infection.

  • Unique Spells / Abilities - Get a random loot of AOE Spells to turn the tide of waves of enemies.

  • Unique Enemies - Lots of enemies, mini boss and boss each have their own specific skills/effect.

  • Level Editor - After completing the main campaign a level editor will be unlocked

Future Features (If got enough fund):

  • More knights & abilities – Max level merge will breed a new tower.

  • Co-op mode – Team up with friends to protect the kingdom together!

  • Multiplayer battles – Challenge others in strategic head-to-head tower defense duels.

  • Endless mode – Survive as long as possible against waves of infected!

Cell Knights: TD is the most infectious tower defense game yet!

⚔️ Demo coming soon!

P.S. Hi I'm a solo developer, and you can follow my progress on YouTube at Nutsaid! Hit that subscribe button to stay updated on Cell Knights: TD and more! 🚀

Minimum:
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GT 730
  • Sound Card: any
  • VR Support: none

short_description: Cell Knights: TD is a Isometric 2.5D cozy tower defense game. Inspired by COC Art Style and WC3 mazing tower defense. Build and strategize your maze, place your towers correctly with each has their own unique shooting mechanics. Perfect for someone who loves tower defense game.
